text:
Two reviews are waiting on you, not on anyone's build: csv-import/02 and speed-up-tests both have a PR up (#57, #42), plus a rendered diff and a runnable demo under `agent/show/` so you can decide from the demo rather than the diff. csv-import/02 is the keystone: its three questions gate 04, and four other tickets depend on that. Meanwhile 03 is claimed and building on landed 01, and flaky-upload-test already has D2 settled, so only the retry-vs-fake-clock call is left.

## next

- csv-import/02: answer D1 to D3; it unblocks the longest chain on the board.
- flaky-upload-test: one question left, 15 minutes, and a p1 clears.
- speed-up-tests: two small calls over a demo; the suite goes from four minutes to under one.

All three are independent, so they can run at the same time, as one wave.
